_schema: Upcoming cohort application windows, enriched just-in-time as we work accelerators. Each entry: {accelerator, dealroom_url, cohort_name, application_open (YYYY-MM-DD), application_close (YYYY-MM-DD — the due date shown on the calendar), program_start (YYYY-MM-DD), apply_url, region}. Only application_close and accelerator are required; the rest are optional. This feeds the 'Application deadlines' calendar and, later, the public open-calls destination. Since 2026-10-08 entries may also carry the Cohort Calendar sweep keys (program, program_end, demo_day, cadence, check_size_terms, status, hq_us, date_confidence, window_status, source_urls, last_checked, list_source); deduped on (application_close, apply_url w/o trailing slash lowercased, cohort_name).
